mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with three consecutive months of declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 9.0% for two consecutive months, it signals severe labor market weakness triggering policy responses and risk appetite, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances with UNRATE > 9.0% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in residential sales (RSAFS) and rise in housing starts (HOUST) indicates housing market recovery, signaling improved consumer confidence and corporate earnings growth that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The RSAFS decline/HOUST rise interaction fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing supply chain recovery (INDPRO > 95.0 for two consecutive months), rising industrial production signals stronger corporate capital expenditure and earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of INDPRO > 95.0 for two consecutive months periods, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation triggering hawkish monetary policy expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days as markets price in imminent rate hikes.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over three consecutive months signals strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of PAYEMS growth periods for three consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in consumer credit (RSAFS) and rise in housing starts (HOUST) indicates shift from credit-driven to inventory-driven consumption, signaling sustainable economic expansion that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The RSAFS decline/HOUST rise interaction fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During low-rate high-inflation regimes (FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%), constrained monetary policy capacity leads to negative equity returns as markets price in imminent rate hikes over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% periods, or the interaction term's Rank IC falls below 0.03.
